shipped_systems.name: VetCheck
shipped_systems.summary: AI Veterinary Clinical Management & Telehealth SaaS serving veterinary practices across the UK and Australia.
shipped_systems.challenge: Clinics needed unified, high-availability practice management with zero-downtime releases and reliable performance during busy clinic consultation hours.
shipped_systems.solution: Engineered an automated Blue/Green deployment pipeline on AWS using Laravel Octane, FrankenPHP, and centralized ElastiCache (Redis/ValKey), ensuring continuous uptime and seamless cutover without clinic disruption.
shipped_systems.verified_impact: Multi-Region UK & AU • Zero-Downtime Deployments • 100% Traffic Cutover Safety

shipped_systems.name: AjakMe
shipped_systems.summary: Modern Digital Wedding Invitation & Guest RSVP SaaS in Malaysia.
shipped_systems.challenge: Couples needed an elegant, straightforward way to design digital invitations, collect RSVPs in real time, generate physical print-ready card exports, and send Telegram guest notifications.
shipped_systems.solution: Built a touch-optimized, clean Livewire 3 + Alpine.js single-page application with automated high-resolution PDF print exports, dynamic QR check-ins, and automated Telegram bot notifications (no WhatsApp integration).
shipped_systems.verified_impact: Production Live • Telegram Bot Notifications • Print-Ready PDF Generator

shipped_systems.name: ACCEA Membership & Room Booking
shipped_systems.summary: Unified Identity, SSO & Flexible Room Reservation Platform for coworking spaces.
shipped_systems.challenge: Enterprise coworking centers needed a single unified identity provider across multiple web properties along with real-time room scheduling to eliminate double bookings.
shipped_systems.solution: Architected a centralized Single Sign-On (SSO) OAuth2 identity provider and connected reservation engine with concurrency-safe booking calendars, payment gateways, and automated member access.
shipped_systems.verified_impact: Unified Single Sign-On • Real-Time Concurrency Calendar • Enterprise Multi-Location

shipped_systems.name: altHR (Digi-X)
shipped_systems.summary: Enterprise HR & Workforce Superapp used by corporate enterprises across Malaysia.
shipped_systems.challenge: Malaysian enterprises required a centralized digital workforce platform managing employee leaves, automated payroll, time tracking, and staff perks at scale.
shipped_systems.solution: Contributed to high-volume microservice APIs, payroll calculations, and scalable mobile backend endpoints supporting tens of thousands of corporate employees across Malaysia.
shipped_systems.verified_impact: High-Volume Enterprise Scale • Microservices Architecture • Fintech & Payroll Integration
